rows.text: La atención es esencial: permite detectar información del tránsito y reaccionar ante peligros. Si se desvía, empeora el desempeño al conducir.
evidence: Commissione europea, Driver distraction (2018), sintesi e sez. 3–4, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/system/files/2021-07/ersosynthesis2018-driverdistraction.pdf: attenzione selettiva e divisa, scansione e prestazioni di guida.

Commissione europea, Distraction, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/eu-road-safety-policy/priorities/safe-road-use/archive/distraction_en: attenzione al traffico, distrazioni visive, cognitive e manuali; fumo e dispositivi.

rows.text: La exigencia mental cambia según la situación: con tránsito intenso o poca visibilidad, detectar y seguir los peligros puede requerir más atención.
evidence: Commissione europea, Lack of driving experience, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/european-road-safety-observatory/statistics-and-analysis-archive/young-people/lack-driving-experience_en: richieste dell’ambiente, pratica, rilevamento dei pericoli e capacità mentale.

Stuiver et al., Short-term cardiovascular measures for driver support, DOI 10.1016/j.ijpsycho.2014.01.010, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24508315/: variazioni della densità di traffico e nebbia come variazioni del carico mentale.

rows.text: La exigencia mental no es independiente del entorno: el tránsito intenso y la poca visibilidad pueden dificultar la detección y el seguimiento de peligros.
evidence: Commissione europea, Lack of driving experience, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/european-road-safety-observatory/statistics-and-analysis-archive/young-people/lack-driving-experience_en: richieste dell’ambiente, pratica, rilevamento dei pericoli e capacità mentale.

Stuiver et al., Short-term cardiovascular measures for driver support, DOI 10.1016/j.ijpsycho.2014.01.010, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24508315/: variazioni della densità di traffico e nebbia come variazioni del carico mentale.

rows.text: La experiencia puede hacer más familiares las situaciones de conducción y reducir algunas formas de ansiedad. Sin embargo, no garantiza automáticamente equilibrio ni ausencia de riesgos.
evidence: Commissione europea, Lack of driving experience, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/european-road-safety-observatory/statistics-and-analysis-archive/young-people/lack-driving-experience_en: richieste dell’ambiente, pratica, rilevamento dei pericoli e capacità mentale.

Understanding the impact of electric vehicle driving experience on range anxiety, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25790577/: esperienza associata a minore ansia da autonomia, esempio specifico non garanzia generale.

rows.text: La ira y la frustración pueden favorecer reacciones agresivas y conductas riesgosas o infracciones; el comportamiento de otros también puede afectar el estado emocional.
evidence: Commissione europea, Driver distraction (2022), sez. 4.6, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/system/files/2022-04/Road_Safety_Thematic_Report_Driver_Distraction_2022.pdf: emozioni come rabbia e stress sono associate a maggiore rischio.

Parker, Lajunen e Summala, Anger and aggression among drivers in three European countries, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/11829293/: comportamento altrui e densità del traffico associati a rabbia e aggressività.

rows.text: La tensión y el cansancio pueden alterar la atención y las reacciones. Reconocerlos y detenerse a descansar cuando sea necesario ayuda a manejarlos.
evidence: Commissione europea, Driving behaviour, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/european-road-safety-observatory/statistics-and-analysis-archive/fatigue/driving-behaviour_en: la fatica riduce vigilanza e rallenta le reazioni.

Commissione europea, Fatigue, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/european-road-safety-observatory/statistics-and-analysis-archive/fatigue/fatigue_en: la guida prolungata senza pause sufficienti aumenta la fatica.

rows.text: El tránsito intenso y las situaciones críticas pueden generar estrés y afectar las emociones y reacciones del conductor: no es cierto que nunca suceda.
evidence: Parker, Lajunen e Summala, Anger and aggression among drivers in three European countries, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/11829293/: comportamento altrui e densità del traffico associati a rabbia e aggressività.

rows.text: Las normas y costumbres del entorno social pueden influir en las actitudes ante el riesgo y, por tanto, en la conducta al conducir.
evidence: Commissione europea, Novice drivers (2021), sintesi, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/document/download/f514ad79-c72b-4519-9ecd-b4ba39bb1047_en?filename=ERSO+thematic+report+Novice+drivers_0.pdf: esperienza, percezione del rischio, fattori sociali e atteggiamenti.

Coogan, Campbell, Adler e Forward, Examining behavioral and attitudinal differences among groups in their traffic safety culture, https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S1369847814000369: associazione tra cultura, atteggiamenti e condotte rischiose.

rows.text: Los hábitos, las actitudes y las experiencias, incluso las adquiridas en la familia y el entorno social, pueden influir en cómo se evalúan los riesgos y se reacciona al conducir.
evidence: Commissione europea, Novice drivers (2021), sintesi, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/document/download/f514ad79-c72b-4519-9ecd-b4ba39bb1047_en?filename=ERSO+thematic+report+Novice+drivers_0.pdf: esperienza, percezione del rischio, fattori sociali e atteggiamenti.

Commissione europea, Novice drivers (2021), fattori sociali, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/document/download/f514ad79-c72b-4519-9ecd-b4ba39bb1047_en?filename=ERSO+thematic+report+Novice+drivers_0.pdf: esempi e confini stabiliti dai genitori influenzano la guida dei giovani.

rows.text: El cuestionario marca VERDADERO. El optimismo irreal y la ilusión de control pueden distorsionar la valoración de las propias capacidades y los peligros. El riesgo real y el percibido son conceptos distintos, no sesgos por sí mismos; una valoración distorsionada puede hacer que difieran.
evidence: Perceived invulnerability in traffic, Frontiers in Public Health (2025), https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/public-health/articles/10.3389/fpubh.2025.1626481/full: study of 115 drivers distinguishes illusion of control and subjective risk perception; discusses optimism bias and control as related but distinct phenomena. Observational self-report, no inference of official intent.

rows.text: El optimismo irrealista puede llevar a subestimar el riesgo o sobreestimar el control sobre la situación, distorsionando el juicio.
evidence: The optimism bias and traffic accident risk perception, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/2765077/: ottimismo e sovrastima del controllo sugli eventi.

rows.text: La cifra del 95% es una estimación de accidentes en los que interviene un factor humano, no una proporción atribuible exclusivamente a las personas: también pueden contribuir el vehículo y la vía.
evidence: Commissione europea, Main factors causing fatal crashes, sez. 2.1, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/document/download/a7428369-8eaf-4032-806e-ea08b46028c0_en?filename=ERSO-TR-MainCauses.pdf: fattori umani contribuiscono a circa il 95% degli incidenti; fattori possono concorrere.

rows.text: Una causa técnica también puede tener un componente humano: por ejemplo, una presión insuficiente por falta de controles puede contribuir a la falla de un neumático.
evidence: NHTSA, TireWise, https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/tires: manutenzione insufficiente e pressione bassa possono portare a scoppio.

rows.text: Manejar las emociones ayuda a mantener la atención y evitar reacciones impulsivas que pueden comprometer la conducción.
evidence: Commissione europea, Driver distraction (2022), sez. 4.6, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/system/files/2022-04/Road_Safety_Thematic_Report_Driver_Distraction_2022.pdf: emozioni come rabbia e stress sono associate a maggiore rischio.

rows.text: Reaccionar pronto ante un peligro deja más margen para actuar. El cansancio y la distracción pueden retrasar la respuesta.
evidence: Commissione europea, Driving behaviour, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/european-road-safety-observatory/statistics-and-analysis-archive/fatigue/driving-behaviour_en: la fatica riduce vigilanza e rallenta le reazioni.

Commissione europea, Driver distraction (2018), sintesi e sez. 3–4, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/system/files/2021-07/ersosynthesis2018-driverdistraction.pdf: attenzione selettiva e divisa, scansione e prestazioni di guida.

rows.text: Observar el tránsito alrededor es fundamental para detectar peligros y decidir cómo reaccionar; por eso importa la capacidad de vigilar la situación.
evidence: Commissione europea, Distraction, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/eu-road-safety-policy/priorities/safe-road-use/archive/distraction_en: attenzione al traffico, distrazioni visive, cognitive e manuali; fumo e dispositivi.

Commissione europea, Lack of driving experience, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/european-road-safety-observatory/statistics-and-analysis-archive/young-people/lack-driving-experience_en: richieste dell’ambiente, pratica, rilevamento dei pericoli e capacità mentale.

rows.text: La coordinación sensoriomotriz permite convertir lo percibido en acciones sobre los mandos, como girar o frenar; no es inútil.
evidence: Commissione europea, Effects of fatigue on driving, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/european-road-safety-observatory/statistics-and-analysis-archive/fatigue/effects-fatigue-driving_en: coordinazione psicomotoria e prestazione di guida.
Interaction of oculomotor and manual behavior, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6565787/: usare informazioni visive per azionare sterzo, acceleratore e freno.

rows.text: Buscar o ajustar los controles de la radio o del navegador puede apartar la vista, las manos y la atención de la conducción, con posibles consecuencias graves.
evidence: Commissione europea, Distraction, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/eu-road-safety-policy/priorities/safe-road-use/archive/distraction_en: attenzione al traffico, distrazioni visive, cognitive e manuali; fumo e dispositivi.
NHTSA, Distracted Driving, https://www.nhtsa.gov/risky-driving/distracted-driving: comandi audio e navigazione distolgono attenzione.

rows.text: Encender un cigarrillo o buscar el cenicero puede apartar la vista, las manos y la atención de la conducción y aumentar el riesgo de accidente.
evidence: Commissione europea, Distraction, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/eu-road-safety-policy/priorities/safe-road-use/archive/distraction_en: attenzione al traffico, distrazioni visive, cognitive e manuali; fumo e dispositivi.

rows.text: El cuestionario marca FALSO, pero «mirarse en el retrovisor» es ambiguo. Revisar el tránsito por el espejo forma parte de la conducción segura; mirarse para arreglarse puede distraer. La frase no aclara a cuál uso se refiere.
evidence: UK Highway Code rule 161, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/using-the-road-159-to-203: use mirrors frequently to check traffic, including before changes of speed or direction; UK driving guidance, not Italian law.

NHTSA, Distractions: In and Out of the Vehicle, https://www.nhtsa.gov/sites/nhtsa.gov/files/driverdistractions.pdf: grooming listed as a potential in-vehicle distraction. Source question leaves mirror use ambiguous; no claim that grooming is its verified official meaning.

rows.text: La situación cambia continuamente: hay que distribuir la atención y desplazar la mirada entre la vía, los vehículos y los demás usuarios para detectar los peligros a tiempo.
evidence: Commissione europea, Distraction, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/eu-road-safety-policy/priorities/safe-road-use/archive/distraction_en: attenzione al traffico, distrazioni visive, cognitive e manuali; fumo e dispositivi.

Commissione europea, Lack of driving experience, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/european-road-safety-observatory/statistics-and-analysis-archive/young-people/lack-driving-experience_en: richieste dell’ambiente, pratica, rilevamento dei pericoli e capacità mentale.

rows.text: Los equipos de protección personal, elegidos según los riesgos del trabajo, protegen a quien los usa durante las actividades expuestas a esos riesgos.
evidence: D.Lgs. 81/2008, art. 77 commi 1 e 3, https://www.normattiva.it/atto/caricaDettaglioAtto?atto.articolo.numero=77&atto.articolo.tipoArticolo=0&atto.codiceRedazionale=008G0104&atto.dataPubblicazioneGazzetta=2008-04-30: valutazione dei rischi, scelta e fornitura DPI da parte del datore.

rows.text: Existen guantes para proteger las manos de riesgos mecánicos, químicos o eléctricos. Deben elegirse para el peligro específico: ningún tipo protege contra todo.
evidence: OSHA, 1910 Subpart I Appendix B §11, https://www.osha.gov/laws-regs/regulations/standardnumber/1910/1910SubpartIAppB: guanti contro tagli e sostanze chimiche; selezione in base al pericolo, nessun guanto protegge da tutti i rischi.

OSHA, Electric Power Generation, Transmission, and Distribution, Insulating Gloves and Sleeves, https://www.osha.gov/etools/electric-power/general/personal-protective-equipment/insulating-gloves-sleeves: guanti isolanti per lavori elettrici, scelti per la tensione prevista.

rows.text: Los anteojos de seguridad, máscaras y caretas adecuados pueden proteger los ojos de partículas y salpicaduras corrosivas. La elección depende del riesgo y de la cobertura necesaria.
evidence: CDC NIOSH, Eye Safety for Workers, https://www.cdc.gov/niosh/ppe/eye-safety/: schegge, ustioni chimiche e protezione appropriata con occhiali, maschere o visiere.

rows.text: El empleador participa en la gestión de la seguridad: evalúa los riesgos para elegir equipos de protección y proporciona equipos adecuados a los trabajadores.
evidence: D.Lgs. 81/2008, art. 77 commi 1 e 3, https://www.normattiva.it/atto/caricaDettaglioAtto?atto.articolo.numero=77&atto.articolo.tipoArticolo=0&atto.codiceRedazionale=008G0104&atto.dataPubblicazioneGazzetta=2008-04-30: valutazione dei rischi, scelta e fornitura DPI da parte del datore.

review.review_evidence: Independently read all 25 source/verdict pairs, four localized outputs and supporting passages; no source figures. For 31859 read Frontiers 2025 §§2–4 (115 online self-report drivers) and distinguished optimism/illusion from risk concepts without inferring quiz intent. For 31869 read UK Highway Code rule 161 and NHTSA Distractions p.1 (grooming); ambiguity remains explicitly visible. For 31851/52 original ScienceDirect URL returned 403; exact same 2014 Stuiver study independently inspected at PubMed PMID24508315 (PII and DOI matched). For 31853 the direct PubMed URL returned blank placeholder; independently inspected exact Rauh et al author manuscript https://citeseerx.ist.psu.edu/document?doi=04b17aa49119fd6b10ade8a64998dd265cbf824e&repid=rep1&type=pdf abstract (12 experienced vs 12 inexperienced BEV drivers); association is specific to range anxiety. For 31860 direct PubMed URL returned blank; independently inspected exact DeJoy abstract as CDC/NLM reprint https://stacks.cdc.gov/view/cdc/81800/cdc_81800_DS1.pdf reference102, p.41. For 31857 ScienceDirect returned 403; independently inspected TRID exact abstract https://trid.trb.org/View/1325320 and Commission novice-driver report PDF p.9. Other sources inspected directly, including EU crash factors p.5 (approximately 95% contributory, not exclusive) and Normattiva art.77. Re-reviewed the exact citation replacement at 31851/31852: Stuiver is first author and PubMed PMID 24508315, DOI 10.1016/j.ijpsycho.2014.01.010, directly supports the fog and density qualifications. Reconstructing the previous draft and comparing its canonical fingerprint verified every other row and text is unchanged.

issues.reason: Il quesito segna VERO ma include rischio reale e rischio percepito tra i bias sociocognitivi: le fonti consultate distinguono il rischio dalla distorsione della sua valutazione. Occorre adjudicazione della terminologia e del verdetto prima di completare la spiegazione.
checked_sources: Ministero delle infrastrutture e dei trasporti, Domande CQC nuovo, quesito 31859, https://ilportaledellautomobilista.it/documents/56611/85457073/DomandeCqcNuovoListato.pdf/9bc6d483-6e0b-41f9-8347-91fd345ceeb9: formula e risposta VERO.
The optimism bias and traffic accident risk perception, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/2765077/: studia ottimismo e percezione del rischio, non identifica rischio reale e percepito come bias.

issues.reason: Il quesito segna FALSO per il guardarsi nello specchio retrovisore senza precisare lo scopo. La lettura come cura personale è plausibile ma non attestata; il controllo dello specchio per osservare il traffico è distinto. Occorre adjudicazione del significato inteso.
checked_sources: Ministero delle infrastrutture e dei trasporti, Domande CQC nuovo, quesito 31869, https://ilportaledellautomobilista.it/documents/56611/85457073/DomandeCqcNuovoListato.pdf/9bc6d483-6e0b-41f9-8347-91fd345ceeb9: formula e risposta FALSO, senza specificare lo scopo.

NHTSA, Driver Inattention, https://www.nhtsa.gov/sites/nhtsa.gov/files/driverinattention.pdf: classifica la cura dei capelli come possibile distrazione, ma non chiarisce il significato inteso nel quesito.

Commissione europea, Distraction, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/eu-road-safety-policy/priorities/safe-road-use/archive/distraction_en: descrive distrazioni, ma non interpreta questo quesito.

issues.reason: The cited article Examining behavioral and attitudinal differences among groups in their traffic safety culture is by Coogan, Campbell, Adler and Forward, not Özkan et al.; correct the evidence attribution in every language.

The printed true assertion lists actual and perceived risk as biases, but these are quantities or concepts, not themselves biases; the draft avoids repeating that claim without flagging the discrepancy. Preserve the verdict and seek source adjudication; make the distinction explicit in all languages.

The explanation assumes looking at oneself for grooming, while the question does not specify that purpose and the localized question can mean checking the rearview mirror for traffic. Evidence establishes grooming as a distraction but not the intended sense of this particular question. Resolve the ambiguity and present any inferred scope transparently in all languages.

The OSHA citation attributes electrical insulating gloves to Appendix B section 11, which discusses cuts and chemicals but does not substantiate that electrical claim; section 10 mentions rubber insulating gloves.
